title: Coach
subtitle: Your AI coach for homework, practice, and big goals.
intro_ask: Ask me about goals, chess strategy, debate, medical school, college applications — anything you're working toward.
intro_homework: I'll teach you step by step with hints and questions — not just give answers — so you really learn it.
intro_interview: I'll be the interviewer. One question at a time, with tips after each answer.
intro_debate: Pick a topic and a side. I'll argue the other side, then coach you on your arguments.
intro_quiz: Tell me a topic and I'll quiz you one question at a time and keep score.
intro_email: I'll teach you how to write emails and short applications — you write, I give tips.
intro_essay: Paste your essay. I'll give feedback without rewriting it, so it stays your work.
intro_language: Practice English or Spanish by chatting. I'll gently fix mistakes as we go.
starter_ask_1: How do I get better at chess fast?
starter_ask_2: What should I do now to get into medical school?
starter_homework_3: How do I write a thesis statement?
starter_interview_1: Practice for a first job at a grocery store
starter_debate_2: Phones should be allowed in class
starter_email_1: Help me email a vet clinic about volunteering
starter_email_2: Help me answer “Why do you want this internship?”
starter_email_3: Help me ask a teacher for a recommendation
starter_language_3: Help me prepare for a conversation in English
